### [MSc Thesis: Turning CO₂ into Useful Chemicals](project/msc-thesis/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

### [Real-time Bacterial Counting](project/realtime-bacteria/index.qmd){.stretched-link}
MEng thesis: pre-treatment methods that remove interfering organic matter so bacteria in wastewater can be counted in real time (Nagasaki University, 2020).
